image_description: A handmade patchwork baby bib featuring squares of green, yellow, and pink floral fabrics. It has a central vertical strip of solid teal fabric with an embroidered pocket depicting a stylized face or character. The neck closure consists of white elastic loops tied in a bow at the top. The bib is laid flat on a neutral beige textured surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not another garment or accessory.
To verify the structural integrity of the patchwork seams and ensure the ties are physically connected to the body without fusion artifacts.
To check for subtle texture inconsistencies in the patchwork patterns or unnatural blurring in the embroidery.

focus_areas: Connection points of the white ties to the main body
Realism of the embroidered pocket details
Texture coherence across different fabric patches
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the patchwork pattern alignment looks physically plausible (do patterns cut off naturally at seams?). Check if the white ties show realistic shadowing where they overlap the bib body. Ensure the embroidery doesn't look like a flat sticker applied on top.
